product.olivetti-lsx-5025.summary: The 33 MHz LSX that moved VGA onto the board and added second-level cache.
product.olivetti-lsx-5025.history: Olivetti offered the LSX 5000 line to medium-sized businesses and departments of large organisations under its OSA architecture. The 1992 brochure offered the 5025 as an open-systems server in the LSX 5000 line.
product.olivetti-lsx-5025.architecture: Storage could be split across two channels. The optional EFP2 controller supports up to fourteen SCSI disks and mirroring.
product.olivetti-lsx-5025.verified: The configuration was checked against the cited sources. BluMach validation is pending.
product.olivetti-lsx-5025.limitations: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
